canonical_units.label: Словарная группа слитно пишущихся наречий из 7-классного источника
canonical_units.learner_rationale_policy: Practise as a dictionary spelling set where no single productive rule safely explains all members. Do not invent a common etymology or mnemonic derivation.
canonical_units.counting_policy: One canonical lexical-set unit at denominator level because the source presents one stable dictionary-spelling task. Runtime practice may split members into smaller exercise clusters without changing denominator identity.
